A pink-haired swordswoman stands gracefully atop shattered stones, cherry blossom-like light swirling around her. Across from her, a purple-haired talisman fighter holds her spell with poise, surrounded by surging energy and eerie silence.

The camera slowly pushes toward the midpoint between them, sweeping sideways through flying rubble and flickering light trails. It ends with a dramatic close-up of their locked eyes — a charged moment suspended before the imminent clash, in a scene full of visual tension and cinematic energy.
